sections.Profile:
The "Space Walk" pinball machine, produced by Gottlieb in January 1979, is notable for being the last electro-mechanical (EM) game made by the company. Designed by Ed Krynski and featuring artwork by Gordon Morison, this two-player machine shares its playfield layout with the solid-state model "Count-Down."

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1979
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Space Fantasy, Two player, Space, Original Theme, 1970s, Sci-Fi
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Ed Krynski
- Art: Gordon Morison
